body.name: One-action no-synergy subclass \(\mathfrak C_{1}\)
body.construction: \(\mathfrak C_{1}=\{(G^{+},\mathcal A,Q):\text{every optional }S\in\Pi\text{ has exactly one positive-cost action, protocol legality is invariant across distinct fresh-unit acquisitions, and each }C_j\text{ is certified by one protocol without cross-protocol synergy}\}\).
